description: This Dart source file defines data models for daily and weekly attendance summaries, and a ReportProvider class that manages fetching, caching, and real-time updating of these reports in a Flutter application. It interacts with an API client, a realtime service, and an authentication provider, facilitating attendance report data handling and updates.

classes.name: DailySummary
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a daily attendance summary with fields for date and attendance counts.

classes.name: WeeklySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a weekly attendance summary with fields for the starting date and aggregated attendance counts.

classes.name: ReportProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that fetches, caches, and listens for real-time updates of daily and weekly attendance reports.

methods.name: DailySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a DailySummary instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a WeeklySummary instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: ReportProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with authentication, API, and realtime services.

methods.name: fetchDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance summary for a specific date, either mocked or via API.

methods.name: fetchWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance summary for a specific week start date, either mocked or via API.
